-- TOC entry 268 (class 1255 OID 98307)
-- Name: add_client_payment(text, text, date, text, numeric, text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.add_client_payment(p_booking_id text, p_client_name text, p_payment_date date, p_payment_type text, p_amount numeric, p_payment_mode text, p_reference_utr text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_package_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_remarks text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(payment_id uuid, booking_selling_price numeric, received_from_client numeric, balance_due numeric)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_payment_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();
  v_selling    NUMERIC;
  v_received   NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  -- Lock booking row
  SELECT selling_price INTO v_selling
  FROM bookings WHERE id = p_booking_id FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO client_payments (
    id, booking_id, client_name, payment_date, payment_type,
    amount, payment_mode, reference_utr, package_name, remarks
  )
  VALUES (
    v_payment_id, p_booking_id, p_client_name, p_payment_date, p_payment_type,
    p_amount, p_payment_mode, p_reference_utr, p_package_name, p_remarks
  );

  UPDATE bookings
  SET received_from_client = received_from_client + p_amount
  WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING received_from_client INTO v_received;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT v_payment_id, v_selling, v_received, (v_selling - v_received);
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.add_vendor_payment(p_booking_id text, p_client_name text, p_vendor_name text, p_date_paid date, p_amount_paid numeric, p_payment_mode text, p_reference_utr text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_package_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_remarks text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(payment_id uuid, vendor_cost numeric, paid_to_vendor numeric, balance_due numeric)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_payment_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();
  v_cost       NUMERIC;
  v_paid       NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  SELECT vendor_cost INTO v_cost
  FROM bookings WHERE id = p_booking_id FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO vendor_payments (
    id, booking_id, client_name, vendor_name, date_paid,
    amount_paid, payment_mode, reference_utr, package_name, remarks
  )
  VALUES (
    v_payment_id, p_booking_id, p_client_name, p_vendor_name, p_date_paid,
    p_amount_paid, p_payment_mode, p_reference_utr, p_package_name, p_remarks
  );

  UPDATE bookings
  SET paid_to_vendor = paid_to_vendor + p_amount_paid
  WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING paid_to_vendor INTO v_paid;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT v_payment_id, v_cost, v_paid, (v_cost - v_paid);
END;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 267 (class 1255 OID 98305)
-- Name: convert_itinerary_to_booking(uuid, uuid, numeric, numeric, text, text, date, integer, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.convert_itinerary_to_booking(p_itinerary_id uuid, p_created_by uuid, p_selling_price numeric, p_vendor_cost numeric, p_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_whatsapp text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_travel_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_guests integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(booking_id text, itinerary_id uuid, selling_price numeric, vendor_cost numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_booking_id TEXT;
  v_status     TEXT;
BEGIN
  -- Validate itinerary exists and is in Published state
  SELECT status INTO v_status
  FROM itineraries
  WHERE id = p_itinerary_id AND created_by = p_created_by
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITINERARY_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  IF v_status != 'Published' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITINERARY_NOT_PUBLISHED: current status is %', v_status;
  END IF;

  -- Generate atomic booking ID
  v_booking_id := 'JG-' || LPAD(nextval('booking_id_seq')::TEXT, 4, '0');

  -- Insert booking
  INSERT INTO bookings (
    id, itinerary_id, selling_price, vendor_cost,
    received_from_client, paid_to_vendor,
    phone, whatsapp, travel_date, guests, notes, created_by
  )
  VALUES (
    v_booking_id, p_itinerary_id, p_selling_price, p_vendor_cost,
    0, 0,
    p_phone, p_whatsapp, p_travel_date, p_guests, p_notes, p_created_by
  );

  -- Update itinerary status
  UPDATE itineraries SET status = 'Converted', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_itinerary_id;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT v_booking_id, p_itinerary_id, p_selling_price, p_vendor_cost, NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ;
END;
$$;

-- TOC entry 264 (class 1255 OID 278528)
-- Name: create_itinerary(integer, integer, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.create_itinerary(p_user_id integer, p_org_id integer, p_vendor_name text, p_client_name text, p_source_md text) RETURNS uuid
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
    v_itinerary_id UUID;
BEGIN
    -- Insert itinerary metadata
    INSERT INTO itineraries (id, user_id, org_id, vendor_name, client_name, status)
    VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), p_user_id, p_org_id, p_vendor_name, p_client_name, 'Draft')
    RETURNING id INTO v_itinerary_id;

    -- Insert .md content
    INSERT INTO itinerary_contents (id, itinerary_id, content_type, content)
    VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), v_itinerary_id, 'source_md', convert_to(p_source_md, 'UTF8'));

    -- Insert .md content
    INSERT INTO itinerary_contents (id, itinerary_id, content_type, content)
    VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), v_itinerary_id, 'edited_md', convert_to(p_source_md, 'UTF8'));

    RETURN v_itinerary_id;
END;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 262 (class 1255 OID 40961)
-- Name: get_booking_details(character varying); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_booking_details(p_booking_id character varying) RETURNS TABLE(booking_id character varying, client_name character varying, vendor_name character varying, package_name character varying, travel_date date, selling_price numeric, received_from_client numeric, client_balance_due numeric, vendor_cost numeric, paid_to_vendor numeric, vendor_balance_due numeric, client_status character varying, client_payments jsonb, vendor_payments jsonb)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
    -- 1. Recalculate totals from payment logs to ensure 100% accuracy
    -- 2. Sync back to bookings table
    UPDATE bookings b
    SET 
        received_from_client = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cp.amount) FROM client_payments cp WHERE cp.booking_id = p_booking_id), 0),
        paid_to_vendor = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(vp.amount_paid) FROM vendor_payments vp WHERE vp.booking_id = p_booking_id), 0),
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE b.booking_id = p_booking_id;

    -- 3. Return enriched booking data + JSON payment histories
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        b.booking_id,
        b.client_name,
        b.vendor_name,
        b.package_name,
        b.travel_date,
        b.selling_price,
        b.received_from_client,
        (b.selling_price - b.received_from_client) AS client_balance_due,
        b.vendor_cost,
        b.paid_to_vendor,
        (b.vendor_cost - b.paid_to_vendor) AS vendor_balance_due,
        b.client_status,
        
        -- Client payments with running total
        COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', cp.id,
                'payment_date', cp.payment_date,
                'payment_type', cp.payment_type,
                'amount', cp.amount,
                'payment_mode', cp.payment_mode,
                'reference_utr', cp.reference_utr,
                'running_total', SUM(cp.amount) OVER (ORDER BY cp.payment_date, cp.id),
                'remarks', cp.remarks
            ) ORDER BY cp.payment_date DESC, cp.id DESC)
            FROM client_payments cp
            WHERE cp.booking_id = b.booking_id
        ), '[]'::jsonb),

        -- Vendor payments with running total
        COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', vp.id,
                'date_paid', vp.date_paid,
                'vendor_name', vp.vendor_name,
                'amount_paid', vp.amount_paid,
                'payment_mode', vp.payment_mode,
                'reference_utr', vp.reference_utr,
                'running_total', SUM(vp.amount_paid) OVER (ORDER BY vp.date_paid, vp.id),
                'remarks', vp.remarks
            ) ORDER BY vp.date_paid DESC, vp.id DESC)
            FROM vendor_payments vp
            WHERE vp.booking_id = b.booking_id
        ), '[]'::jsonb)

    FROM bookings b
    WHERE b.booking_id = p_booking_id;
END;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION public.get_booking_details(p_booking_id character varying) OWNER TO neondb_owner;

--
-- TOC entry 269 (class 1255 OID 262147)
-- Name: get_dashboard_summary(integer, integer, boolean); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_summary(p_user_id integer, p_org_id integer, p_is_admin boolean) RETURNS TABLE(total_bookings bigint, pending_bookings bigint, confirmed_bookings bigint, completed_bookings bigint, cancelled_bookings bigint, total_itineraries bigint, draft_itineraries bigint, published_itineraries bigint, converted_itineraries bigint, total_selling_price numeric, total_received numeric, total_vendor_cost numeric, total_paid_to_vendor numeric, client_balance_due numeric, vendor_balance_due numeric, gross_profit numeric, net_profit numeric, unrealised_profit numeric, collection_rate numeric, vendor_pay_rate numeric, conversionrate bigint)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  SELECT
    COUNT(b.booking_id)                                                     AS total_bookings,
    COUNT(b.booking_id) FILTER (WHERE b.client_status = 'Pending')          AS pending_bookings,
    COUNT(b.booking_id) FILTER (WHERE b.client_status = 'Confirmed')        AS confirmed_bookings,
    COUNT(b.booking_id) FILTER (WHERE b.client_status = 'Completed')        AS completed_bookings,
    COUNT(b.booking_id) FILTER (WHERE b.client_status = 'Cancelled')        AS cancelled_bookings,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.id)                                                    AS total_itineraries,  
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'Draft')                  AS draft_itineraries,  
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'Published')              AS published_itineraries,  
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'Converted')              AS converted_itineraries,  

    COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0)                                       AS total_selling_price,
    COALESCE(SUM(cp_agg.total_received), 0)                                 AS total_received,
    COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0)                                         AS total_vendor_cost,
    COALESCE(SUM(vp_agg.total_paid), 0)                                     AS total_paid_to_vendor,

    COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(cp_agg.total_received), 0)                             AS client_balance_due,

    COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(vp_agg.total_paid), 0)                                 AS vendor_balance_due,

    COALESCE(SUM(cp_agg.total_received), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(vp_agg.total_paid), 0)                                 AS gross_profit,

    COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0)                                     AS net_profit,

    COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(cp_agg.total_received), 0)                             AS unrealised_profit,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(cp_agg.total_received), 0)
            / COALESCE(SUM(b.selling_price), 0)) * 100
    END                                                                     AS collection_rate,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(vp_agg.total_paid), 0)
            / COALESCE(SUM(b.vendor_cost), 0)) * 100
    END                                                                     AS vendor_pay_rate,

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE (COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'Converted')
            / COUNT(DISTINCT i.id)) * 100
    END                                                                     AS conversionRate    
  FROM itineraries i
  LEFT JOIN bookings b ON i.id = b.itinerary_id  
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT booking_id, SUM(amount) AS total_received
    FROM client_payments
    GROUP BY booking_id
  ) cp_agg ON b.booking_id = cp_agg.booking_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT booking_id, SUM(amount_paid) AS total_paid
    FROM vendor_payments
    GROUP BY booking_id
  ) vp_agg ON b.booking_id = vp_agg.booking_id
  WHERE
    CASE
      WHEN p_is_admin THEN i.org_id = p_org_id
      ELSE i.user_id = p_user_id
    END
  GROUP BY i.org_id, i.user_id;  
$$;

-- Name: revert_booking_to_itinerary(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.revert_booking_to_itinerary(p_itinerary_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_booking_id TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT id INTO v_booking_id
  FROM bookings WHERE itinerary_id = p_itinerary_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM client_payments WHERE booking_id = v_booking_id;
  DELETE FROM vendor_payments WHERE booking_id = v_booking_id;
  DELETE FROM bookings WHERE id = v_booking_id;

  UPDATE itineraries
  SET status = 'Published', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_itinerary_id;

  RETURN TRUE;
END;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION public.revert_booking_to_itinerary(p_itinerary_id uuid) OWNER TO neondb_owner;

--
-- TOC entry 263 (class 1255 OID 40962)
-- Name: sync_booking_payments(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: neondb_owner
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sync_booking_payments() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
    v_booking_id uuid;
BEGIN
    -- Capture affected booking_id
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        v_booking_id := OLD.booking_id;
    ELSE
        v_booking_id := NEW.booking_id;
    END IF;

    -- Update bookings table with real-time totals
    UPDATE bookings
    SET 
        received_from_client = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM client_payments WHERE booking_id = v_booking_id), 0),
        paid_to_vendor = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM vendor_payments WHERE booking_id = v_booking_id), 0),
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE booking_id = v_booking_id;

    RETURN NULL; -- AFTER triggers ignore return value
END;
$$;
